data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2488 reported a significant release of prior year reserves in 2014. The movement note and managing agent commentary quantify prior period reserve releases of GBP 103.7m, driven primarily by favourable claims development across aviation, marine, financial lines, property and inwards reinsurance, supported by benign catastrophe experience (aggregate natural catastrophe related losses after reinsurance were small at GBP 5.0m). A notable prior-year release is recorded in relation to World Trade Centre losses (September 2001).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement sourced from Note 4 "Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" (total 103,741 GBP '000) and corroborated by Managing Agent narrative. The note presents a single column (no explicit 'Insurance liabilities' vs 'Reinsurer's share' columns) - the figure has been treated as a gross prior year release per the movement note and supporting narrative. No gross claims development triangle was found in the available pages. Mapping of the combined category "Marine, aviation and transport" to single standard LOBs in lob_movements required judgement; "Miscellaneous" mapping to a standard LOB is ambiguous. These mapping choices lower confidence for those LOB-specific amounts.
